item.title: Booklight PA: Explore the creation of beloved Harriett’s Bookshop in ‘Shut Up and Read’
item.description: “Shut Up and Read” is not just a saying for Jeannine Cook. It’s an affirmation, a prayer, and the title of her new memoir. Shut Up and Read follows Cook’s life from being raised by a blind librarian, to fleeing abuse and creating the iconic Harriett’s Bookshop in Philadelphia. Cook writes about how she found her purpose, community, and survived the COVID-19 pandemic when many shops could not. item.description: HARRISBURG — As data centers spread and draw backlash across the state, new figures are emerging about their potential long-term costs.
